essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.

sections.SUMMARY: Boon hand enacts glory-giving; principle-fixed glory-stainless ever. Fearless uprooting always shown; grace-cause-nature palmed. Māyā's shattered head borne by supreme waking shown. Essence-taken rest massed; skull-pretext commands. Wild-played instruments shown; triple-split sound heard standing. Parā-triple lovely imitated gods-outside, trident-pretext, always. Will-shown lower-three; thunder-made power six-spoked borne. World tamed all-held; staff-held Bhairava revealed to us. Mace-axe borne bindu-mirrored; split-bent pointed. Vision-differed assumed; waking-made proclaimed; abode everywhere.

rasa.dominant: vīra of enacted glory; vīra of uprooted fears; vīra of shattered Māyā; vīra of commanded rest; nāda-vīra of heard sound; vīra of mirrored gods; vīra of borne thunderbolt; vīra of tamed world; vīra of pointed splitting; vīra of proclaimed abode
rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at unstained enactment; utsāha at palmed grace; utsāha at skull-borne waking; utsāha at pretext-command; nādotsāha at triple-heard; utsāha at outside-mirrored; utsāha at six-spoked bearing; utsāha at staff-revealed; utsāha at bent indicated; utsāha at everywhere-abode
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: enacted glory, unstained principle. Enacting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: uprooted fears, palmed grace. Uprooting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shattered, borne, shown. Shattering relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: taken, massed, commanded. Commanding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: played, split, heard, standing. Sounding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: lovely, mirrored, always. Mirroring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shown low, borne high. Bearing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: tamed, held, revealed. Revealing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: borne, bent, pointed. Pointing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: assumed, proclaimed, everywhere. Proclaiming relished.
